column4: (1) Without prejudice to any judicial or other remedy

column3: provided for by or under any written law, any person with a
legitimate  interest  shall  be  entitled  to  apply  by  way  of
petition addressed to the High Court seeking the enforcement
of sections 7, 14, 15, 16 or 19 of this Act and to plead for
such relief or redress as shall be prayed for in such petition.

column4: (2) The jurisdiction of the High Court may be invoked

column3: under  subsection  (1)  of  this  section  by  any  person  with  a
legitimate interest, by himself or through any other person
on his behalf, within three months of the date on which the
non-enforcement of sections 7, 14, 15, 16 or 19 of this Act
becomes known to such person, as the case may be.

column4: (3) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any other

column3: law, the High Court may, where it considers it appropriate at
any stage of the proceeding relating to a petition made to it
under subsection (1) of this section, refer such matter to the
Human Rights Commission of Sri Lanka for an inquiry and
report and request such Commission to submit its report to
the High Court within such time as shall be stipulated by the
Court for that purpose.

column4: (4)  The  High  Court  shall  have  the  power  to  grant  the

column3: relief prayed for in a petition made to it under subsection (1)

consider just and equitable, in the circumstances of the case.
